heading:
Built by artists,
for artists.
Engineered at MIT.
Made in Brooklyn.
body: For twelve years we've built machines and methods alongside some of the world's most celebrated artists. Now there are two ways to work with us: the Oil Edition, made affordable and open to every artist, and the Studio, for work that goes further.
